machines.title: Клієнт
machines.setup: ifconfig eth0 hw ether {mac} 10.0.10.2 netmask 255.255.255.0 up; route add default gw 10.0.10.1

machines.title: Роутер
machines.setup: ip link set eth0 address {mac}; ip link set eth0 up; ip link add link eth0 name eth0.10 type vlan id 10; ip link add link eth0 name eth0.20 type vlan id 20; ip addr add 10.0.10.1/24 dev eth0.10; ip addr add 10.0.20.1/24 dev eth0.20; ip link set eth0.10 up; ip link set eth0.20 up; echo 1 > /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_forward

machines.title: Сервер
machines.setup: ifconfig eth0 hw ether {mac} 10.0.20.2 netmask 255.255.255.0 up; route add default gw 10.0.20.1
